sections.title: Methods
paragraphs: Three connected projects turn paired golf videos into interpretable 3D movement: reconstruct the swing, align the recordings in time, and extract measurements with explicit definitions. Each project below explains one part of that workflow.

projects.title: Golf Swing 3D Reconstruction
projects.summary: Two camera views become one inspectable 3D swing. A hybrid pipeline estimates camera geometry and reconstructs body and club movement without a separate calibration session.

projects.title: Two-Event Time Synchronization
projects.summary: Independent recordings must describe the same moment. Two shared swing events align their starting offsets and relative timing, improving the consistency of multi-view reconstruction.

banner.label: Face-on synchronized golf swing reconstruction preview

projects.title: Pose Information Extraction
projects.summary: Reconstructed motion becomes interpretable measurements. Explicit reference systems and geometric definitions connect body rotation and translation metrics to visual explanations.
